;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Battle of Baghuz Fawqani]]
***The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] reports that the [[United States|U.S.]]-backed [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] have taken control of [[Al-Baghuz Fawqani]], following the surrender of the last remaining [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] militants in the town. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-islamicstate/sdf-take-control-of-last-is-enclave-in-east-syria-observatory-idUSKCN1Q5064 (Reuters)]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**Militants attacked an [[Egyptian Army|army]] checkpoint in [[Sinai Peninsula]] killing and injuring 15. It is believed that 11 soldiers were killed but that has not been confirmed. Seven militants also died in the attack. [https://www.thenational.ae/world/mena/militant-attack-kills-and-wounds-15-soldiers-in-egypt-s-sinai-1.826472 (''The National'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/egypt-7-sinai-jihadists-killed-15-soldiers-dead-or-wounded-in-attack/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Boko Haram]] suicide bombers and a gunman kill 8 and injure 15 in an attack in [[Maiduguri]], [[Nigeria]]. All three attackers were later killed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/killed-boko-haram-attack-nigeria-190216120448266.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (1978–present)|Afghanistan War]]
**32 Afghan border security troops are killed by a [[Taliban]] attack in [[Kandahar]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/16/world/asia/taliban-attack-afghan-security.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 24 miners are found dead and dozens are still missing after two mines were flooded two days ago in [[Battlefields, Zimbabwe|Battlefields]], [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/rescued-flooded-zimbabwe-gold-mines-190217051926716.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Nigerian general election]]
**Voting is delayed in [[Nigeria]] for a week, hours before polling was due to start because of violent incidents in the lead up to the election. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47263122 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit Vietnam]]
**[[Chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea|North Korean Chairman]] [[Kim Jong-un]] is to arrive in [[Vietnam]] on February 25 ahead of the second summit meeting between the two leaders on February 27–28 in [[Hanoi]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-vietnam/kim-jong-un-to-arrive-in-vietnam-on-february-25-ahead-of-trump-summit-idUSKCN1Q50FY (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[United States]] [[US Air Force|Air Force]] [[Boeing C-17 Globemaster III|C-17]]s land at [[Cúcuta]] near the [[Colombia–Venezuela border]], the aircraft are loaded with humanitarian aid intended for Venezuela. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/us-military-planes-head-venezuela-aid-61120758 (ABC News)]
*[[Political appointments of the first Trump administration|Political appointments by Donald Trump]]
** [[Spokesperson for the United States Department of State|State Department spokesperson]] [[Heather Nauert]] withdraws from consideration for the [[United States Ambassador to the United Nations|U.S. ambassador to the United Nations]] nomination. [[Jonathan R. Cohen|Jonathan Cohen]] has been serving in that position since January 1, 2019, following [[Nikki Haley]]'s resignation. [https://www.npr.org/2019/02/16/695503995/heather-nauert-withdraws-from-consideration-for-u-n-ambassador (NPR)]
